source_reachability:
All four recorded sources plus the four cross-check URLs resolve to the real documents. Statuses I saw myself on 2026-09-16 with curl -A "Mokaair-editorial":
(1) EBA 2026-02-12 press release https://www.eba.europa.eu/publications-and-media/press-releases/eba-advises-national-authorities-actions-take-end-transition-period-under-its-no-action-letter — HTTP 200, text/html, 57,332 bytes, Server: Apache, X-Generator: EBA Magic. Real article body, page label "Press Release / 12 February 2026". No WAF/challenge/Access-Denied body.
(2) Opinion PDF https://www.eba.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2026-02/3b8b6f18-ca26-4ce1-83eb-d060276f3301/Opinion%20on%20the%20end%20of%20the%20NAL%20transition%20period.pdf — HTTP 200, application/pdf, Content-Length 162135, Last-Modified: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 12:06:15 GMT. Genuine PDF 1.7, 4 pages, 10,646 chars extracted, cover reads "EBA/OP/2026/01 12 February 2026". URL is a link target in (1), so not guessed.
(3) EBA 2025-06-10 press release https://www.eba.europa.eu/publications-and-media/press-releases/eba-publishes-no-action-letter-interplay-between-payment-services-directive-psd23-and-markets-crypto — HTTP 200, text/html, 58,227 bytes, real body, page label "Press Release / 10 June 2025".
(4) No-Action Letter PDF https://www.eba.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2025-06/e2958c99-a1b0-4b07-9d31-bcba0a28dbe7/Opinion%20on%20the%20interplay%20between%20PSD2%20and%20MiCA.pdf — HTTP 200, application/pdf, Content-Length 498051, Last-Modified: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:57:11 GMT. PDF 1.7, 33 pages, 100,899 chars. URL is a link target in (3). The Last-Modified header independently confirms the researcher's "live document" warning: the file under /2025-06/ was regenerated on 2026-02-17.
(5) https://www.eba.europa.eu/publications-and-media/press-releases?text=MiCa&topic=All&date= — HTTP 200, 75,389 bytes, 15 result rows; server-side keyword filtering confirmed (a different result set comes back for the PSD2 query).
(6) https://www.eba.europa.eu/publications-and-media/press-releases?text=PSD2&topic=All&date= — HTTP 200, 75,465 bytes, 15 result rows.
(7) https://www.esma.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2024-12/List_of_MiCA_grandfathering_periods_art._143_3.pdf — HTTP/2 200, application/pdf, 252,095 bytes, last-modified: Wed, 20 May 2026 06:49:46 GMT, embedded ModDate D:20260519140606+02'00', 3 pages. Live document under a dated path, exactly as the BRIEF warns. It is linked from https://www.esma.europa.eu/esmas-activities/digital-finance-and-innovation/markets-crypto-assets-regulation-mica (HTTP 200 to curl), so the URL was discoverable, not guessed.
(8) Commission letter https://www.eba.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2024-12/3225040c-5f3d-410f-9156-f06a43231938/Letter%20to%20EBA%20and%20ESMA%20on%20the%20interplay%20between%20MiCA%20and%20PSD2.pdf — HTTP 200, application/pdf, 429,063 bytes, 3 pages. The URL is a link annotation inside the NAL PDF, so not guessed.
Feed claims re-tested: https://www.eba.europa.eu/publications-and-media/press-releases/rss.xml returns HTTP 404 (328 bytes) as recorded; https://www.eba.europa.eu/rss.xml returns HTTP 200 with 10 items, all "EBA E-mail alert" digests (newest at my fetch 2026-09-16 15:30 UTC, vs the 2026-09-14 the researcher saw earlier the same day) — unusable as a news feed, as recorded.

refuted.fact: F14 tail: 「EBA 表示…超過 100 家 CASP…新聞稿與意見書第 4 段用的是同一句話。」
refuted.why: The >100 figure itself is confirmed in both documents, but the sub-claim that they use the same sentence is false. Opinion para 4: 'The EBA is aware that, since the publication of the NAL, more than 100 CASPs have approached NCAs informally or have submitted an application for authorisation as payment service providers.' Press release: 'Since the publication of the No-Action Letter, more than 100 CASPs have approached national competent authorities informally or submitted an application for authorisation as payment service providers (PSPs).' Different opening clause, 'NCAs' vs 'national competent authorities', 'have submitted' vs 'submitted'. Rewrite as '兩份文件都寫超過 100 家，用字略有不同'.

refuted.fact: F46: 「NAL 原文執行摘要說明 EMT 的雙重性質問題：…EMT 同時是 MiCA 下的加密資產與 PSD2 下的『資金』，因此 CASP 以 EMT 提供支付服務時，需要另外持有 PSP 授權或與 PSP 合作。」
refuted.why: Wrong location. I read the entire Executive Summary (from the cover through to 'Introduction and legal basis', ~9,100 chars of flattened text): it contains no dual-nature passage and never uses the phrase 'dual nature'. The content described is NAL paragraphs 1-2 under 'Introduction and legal basis': MiCA Article 48(2) deems EMTs to be electronic money so they fall within the PSD2 Article 4(25) definition of 'funds'; 'This means that EMTs have a dual nature being, at the same time, crypto-assets regulated under MiCA, and electronic money/funds within the meaning of PSD2. Article 70(4) of MiCA provides that CASPs which intend to provide payment services related to the crypto-asset service they offer, may either do it themselves or partner with a PSP...'. The only other 'dual nature' occurrence in the NAL is para 24. Fix the attribution and the quote.

unsupported.fact: F46 verbatim_quote: 'This No Action letter aims to clarify the interplay by providing advice'
unsupported.why: The sentence is genuinely in the Executive Summary, but it evidences none of the fact it is attached to — no Article 48(2), no Article 4(25), no dual nature, no PSP partnering. As recorded the fact is not traceable to its quote, which is the one thing the BRIEF requires.

unsupported.fact: F48: 「2026-02-12 之後，EBA 沒有再發布任何重新檢視 No-Action Letter 過渡期的新聞稿。」
unsupported.why: The four dated headlines the fact lists are confirmed verbatim on the page I fetched (29 JUNE 2026 supervisory convergence report, 26 JUNE 2026 MiCA fines methodology consultation, 16 JUNE 2026 2025 Annual Report, 2 JUNE 2026 EBA–NYDFS MoU). The absence conclusion is not on any page — it is an inference from one keyword filter ('MiCa') over a 15-row listing, and a press release not containing that keyword would never appear. Demote to a methodology note ('以 EBA 新聞稿清單查核到 2026-09-16 未見'); never write it as something EBA confirmed.

unsupported.fact: F49: 「兩者之間與之後都沒有其他與此過渡期有關的新聞稿。」
unsupported.why: Same problem, and here the unqualified wording is actively misleading: the PSD2-filtered listing does return rows between those two dates (8 JULY 2025 third-party risk consultation, 5 DECEMBER 2025 PI/EMI authorisation peer review, 15 DECEMBER 2025 joint EBA–ECB payment fraud report). Only the 'related to this transition period' qualifier makes the sentence true, and it has to be stated, not implied.

unsupported.fact: F02 / F03 / F14 traceability: sub-claims that only the press-release page can support are attached to the Opinion PDF url.
unsupported.why: All three sub-claims are true — I verified 'EBA/OP/2026/01' appears 0 times in the press-release HTML (only 'EBA/Op/2025/08' appears), and the page does carry the download label 'Opinion on the end of the No-action Letter transition period (158.33 KB - PDF)' against an actual 162,135-byte file. But the url field on those facts points at the PDF, which cannot support them. Split each fact so every claim sits under the one url that carries it.

unsupported.fact: F45 is_vendor_claim=false on 'EBA 在意見書定稿前兩個月舉辦專門工作坊，向超過 100 家 CASP、支付機構與信用機構徵詢初步想法'
unsupported.why: The wording is confirmed verbatim in NAL para 6, but this is the same kind of self-reported, externally unverifiable headcount that the researcher correctly flagged as a claim in F14. Mark it is_vendor_claim=true and write it as 'EBA 表示…' so the two '100' figures get consistent treatment.

unsupported.fact: F41 verbatim_quote reads '...as a payment service andthe custodial wallet as a payment account...'
unsupported.why: The NAL reads 'as a payment service and the custodial wallet as a payment account under the PSD2'. The sourcing note claims extraction spacing was normalised to single spaces; here a space was deleted instead. Substance unaffected, but fix it before anyone copies the quote.

additional_findings: Missing material identifiers: Opinion para 1 names the instruments formally — 'the revised Directive (EU) 2015/2366 on payment services in the internal market (PSD2)' and 'the Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 on markets in crypto-assets (MiCA)'. Neither '2015/2366' nor '2023/1114' appears anywhere in the 51 facts. For a regulatory article these are the load-bearing statutory numbers, and the writer must take them from a fetched page rather than from memory.

Missing: the legal mechanism behind the whole story, NAL paras 1-2 — MiCA Article 48(2) deems EMTs to be electronic money, so they fall inside the PSD2 Article 4(25) definition of 'funds'; MiCA Article 70(4) lets a CASP either provide the payment service itself or partner with an authorised PSP. This is what F46 should have cited and it is the cleanest one-paragraph explanation of the dual-licence problem in any of the four sources.

Missing: Opinion para 9's standalone caveat, which sits after condition D and is not part of it — 'The preliminary assessment referred to at the beginning of condition D does not prevent the NCA under PSD2 from eventually rejecting the application.' F22 folds it into condition D; it is a separate indented sentence.

Missing: the NAL's long-term legislative advice, which is the lead of the 2025 press release ('advising the EU Commission, EU Council and EU Parliament to ensure that, in the long term, EU law needs to avoid a dual authorisation for the activity of transacting electronic money tokens') and NAL para 24 (amend MiCA so CASPs providing EMT payment services 'need only be authorised and supervised under MiCA, and are not required to be authorised under PSD2/PSD3'). Nothing in the record captures it, although it is the point of the letter.

Better first-party dating than PDF metadata: the HTTP Last-Modified headers. op2026.pdf returns 'Last-Modified: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 12:06:15 GMT' (publication day) and nal2025.pdf returns 'Last-Modified: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:57:11 GMT', independently corroborating F06 and F47 without relying on embedded Word metadata.

Arithmetic observation the writer must NOT assert: EBA's 'nine months' is exactly 2 June 2025 to 2 March 2026 and is not the span from 10 June 2025. EBA never shows the calculation, so this cannot be used to argue which NAL date is 'right'. It reinforces the researcher's own must_not_write rule against computing the length independently.

Consistency counts I ran that the record does not mention: '2 March 2026' appears 4 times in the Opinion (paras 2, 4, 7, 13) and 3 times in the NAL (paras 18, 45, 46), while the NAL Executive Summary's '1 March 2026' is a single isolated occurrence — which supports treating it as the NAL's own typo rather than a different rule.

The 2025 press release labels its download '486.38 KB - PDF' against an actual 498,051 bytes, the same KiB convention as the 2026 page's '158.33 KB' against 162,135 bytes. Useful if the writer states either file size.

No disqualifying sourcing found. All 51 facts carry eba.europa.eu or esma.europa.eu urls. No news outlet, aggregator, law-firm blog or search snippet appears as a source url anywhere; the law-firm and media names are confined to unverified_or_excluded, which is where crypto.md requires them.

No guessed identifiers found. Both EBA PDF UUID paths are link targets in the corresponding press-release HTML; the Commission letter UUID path is a link annotation inside the NAL PDF; the ESMA grandfathering PDF is linked from ESMA's own MiCA activities page. Article numbers 29(1)(a), 14(7), 22(1), 93(1), 5, 59, 63, 143(3), 96(6), 97, 98, 9c, 48(2), 70(4), 4(25) and the references EBA-GL-2017-09 and EBA/GL/2018/05 are all present verbatim in the extracted documents.

Date conflation check: clean. The record keeps apart 2026-02-12 (adoption/publication, the event date), 2026-02-11 (PDF production, explicitly excluded), 2026-03-02 (end of the transition period, the subject not the event), 2025-06-10 vs 2025-06-02 (the NAL's real date vs EBA's own erroneous restatement, correctly recorded as a discrepancy), 2026-07-01 (MiCA Art 143(3) national ceiling, correctly fenced off to the C2 article), 2024-12-05 vs 2024-12-06 (Commission letter e-signature vs receipt) and 2026-02-17 (NAL PDF regeneration). This is the strongest part of the submission.

Repo claims verified independently: apps/api/app/guides/content holds 970 files and 0 matching crypto-news-*; the MiCA/PSD2 grep hits are false positives from 'dynamically' containing 'mica'.
